ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and basal regions, with 30% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal lobe tips and along the trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity block occupying the central fluke area. High-intensity contiguous regions are mapped to the distal left and right lobes. Extensive mid-tone mottling and pixel-level stippling are visible at the interface between the dark center and white tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-measured angle of approximately 42 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations across the entire trailing edge. Amplitudes vary between 5 to 20 pixels, creating a jagged interface against the background water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct upward concave curvature starting from the median notch and extending symmetrically towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, high-contrast circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and along segments of the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned linear pixel tracks visible on the high-intensity white background of the left lobe tip, showing a vertical-oblique orientation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant peripheral accumulation of multi-tonal calcified structures (barnacles) at the lobe extremities and multiple dark linear rake marks on the white pigmented sections.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme jaggedness of the trailing edge combined with the heavy peripheral colonization creates a highly unique, non-uniform fluke silhouette.
